unitAI-anjk2.description:
PROBLEM: While adding setup-specialists docs, verified that `sp edit <name> --fork-from <base> --dry-run` still writes `.specialists/user/<name>.specialist.json` before rendering the dry-run diff. Also help advertises `sp edit <name> --fork-from <base> [--dry-run]` as a standalone fork command, but parseArgs rejects it with missing dot-path unless a field/value is supplied.

SUCCESS: Dry-run performs no filesystem writes; either standalone fork works as documented or help/docs clearly require dot-path/value; regression tests cover both.

SCOPE: src/cli/edit.ts, tests for edit command.

VALIDATION: dry-run fork leaves git status unchanged; standalone fork behavior matches help.
